pairs: Hæc quoque lex hostiæ pro delicto,
Likewise, this is the law of the sacrifice for a transgression.
Sancta sanctorum est:
It is the Holy of holies.
idcirco ubi immolabitur holocaustum,
Therefore,
mactabitur
where the holocaust is immolated,
et victima pro delicto:
the victim for a transgression shall also be slain.
sanguis ejus per gyrum altaris fundetur.
Its blood shall be poured out all around the altar.
Offerent ex ea caudam et adipem qui operit vitalia:
They shall offer from it: the rump, and the fat that covers the vital organs,
duos renunculos,
the two little kidneys,
et pinguedinem quæ juxta ilia est,
and the fat that is near the sides,
reticulumque jecoris cum renunculis.
and the mesh of the liver with the little kidneys.
Et adolebit ea sacerdos super altare:
And the priest shall burn them upon the altar.
incensum est Domini pro delicto.
It is the incense of the Lord on behalf of a transgression.
Omnis masculus de sacerdotali genere, in loco sancto vescetur his carnibus,
Every male of priestly descent shall feed on this flesh in a holy place,
quia Sanctum sanctorum est.
because it is the Holy of holies.
Sicut pro peccato offertur hostia,
Just as the sacrifice for sin is offered,
ita et pro delicto:
so also for a transgression;
utriusque hostiæ lex una erit:
one law shall be for both sacrifices.
ad sacerdotem, qui eam obtulerit, pertinebit.
It shall belong to the priest who offers it.
Sacerdos qui offert holocausti victimam, habebit pellem ejus.
The priest who offers the victim of holocaust shall have its skin.
Et omne sacrificium similæ, quod coquitur in clibano,
And every sacrifice of fine wheat flour which is baked in the oven,
et quidquid in craticula, vel in sartagine præparatur,
and whatever is prepared on the oven grating or in the frying pan,
ejus erit sacerdotis a quo offertur:
shall be for the priest who offers it.
sive oleo conspersa,
Whether these will be sprinkled with oil,
sive arida fuerint,
or left dry,
cunctis filiis Aaron mensura æqua per singulos dividetur.
an equal measure shall be divided to each one of the sons of Aaron.
Hæc est lex hostiæ pacificorum quæ offertur Domino.
This is the law of the victim of peace offerings, which is offered to the Lord.
Si pro gratiarum actione oblatio fuerit,
If the oblation will be an act for giving thanks,
offerent panes absque fermento conspersos oleo,
they shall offer bread without leaven sprinkled with oil,
et lagana azyma uncta oleo,
and unleavened wafers anointed with oil,
coctamque similam,
and fine wheat flour fried,
et collyridas olei admistione conspersas:
and cakes sprinkled and mixed with oil,
panes quoque fermentatos cum hostia gratiarum,
and also, leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving,
quæ immolatur pro pacificis:
which is immolated for peace offerings.
ex quibus unus pro primitiis offeretur Domino,
Of these, one shall be offered to the Lord as the first-fruits,
et erit sacerdotis qui fundet hostiæ sanguinem,
and one shall be for the priest who will pour out the blood of the victim.
cujus carnes eadem comedentur die,
The flesh of it shall be eaten on the same day;
nec remanebit ex eis quidquam usque mane.
neither shall any of it remain until morning.
Si voto,
If anyone,
vel sponte quispiam obtulerit hostiam,
by a vow or of his own accord,
eadem similiter edetur die:
will have offered a sacrifice,
sed
it shall be eaten in a similar manner on the same day.
et si quid in crastinum remanserit,
But then if any of it will have remained until tomorrow,
vesci licitum est:
it is lawful to eat it.
quidquid autem tertius invenerit dies, ignis absumet.
Then whatever will be found on the third day shall be consumed with fire.
Si quis de carnibus victimæ pacificorum die tertio comederit,
If anyone will have eaten from the flesh of the victim of peace offerings on the third day,
irrita fiet oblatio,
the oblation will be nullified;
nec proderit offerenti:
neither will it benefit the one who offered it.
quin potius quæcumque anima tali se edulio contaminaverit,
But instead,
prævaricationis rea erit.
whatever soul will contaminate itself with such foods will be guilty of a betrayal.
Caro, quæ aliquid tetigerit immundum, non comedetur,
The flesh that has touched anything unclean shall not be eaten,
sed comburetur igni:
but it shall be burnt with fire.
qui fuerit mundus, vescetur ex ea.
He that is clean will feed on it.
Anima polluta quæ ederit de carnibus hostiæ pacificorum,
If a soul which is polluted will have eaten from the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings,
quæ oblata est Domino,
which is offered to the Lord,
peribit de populis suis.
he shall perish from his people.
Et quæ tetigerit immunditiam hominis,
And whoever will have touched the uncleanness of man,
vel jumenti,
or of beast,
sive omnis rei quæ polluere potest,
or of anything which is able to defile,
et comederit de hujuscemodi carnibus,
and who will have eaten from this kind of flesh,
interibit de populis suis.
shall be cut off from his people.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël:
Say to the sons of Israel:
Adipem ovis,
The fat of a sheep,
et bovis,
and of an ox,
et capræ non comedetis.
and of a goat you shall not eat.
Adipem cadaveris morticini,
The fat of a carcass that has died on its own,
et ejus animalis, quod a bestia captum est,
or of an animal that has been seized by a wild beast,
habebitis in varios usus.
you shall have for various uses.
Si quis adipem, qui offerri debet in incensum Domini, comederit,
If anyone will have eaten the fat which ought to be offered as a burnt sacrifice of the Lord,
peribit de populo suo.
he shall perish from his people.
Sanguinem quoque omnis animalis non sumetis in cibo,
Likewise, you shall not take as food the blood of any animals at all,
tam de avibus quam de pecoribus.
whether of birds or beasts.
Omnis anima, quæ ederit sanguinem, peribit de populis suis.
Every soul that will have eaten blood shall perish from his people.
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël,
Speak to the sons of Israel,
dicens:
saying:
Qui offert victimam pacificorum Domino,
Whoever offers a victim of peace offerings to the Lord,
offerat simul et sacrificium,
let him also offer at the same time a sacrifice,
id est,
that is,
libamenta ejus.
its libations.
Tenebit manibus adipem hostiæ,
He shall hold in his hands the fat of the victim,
et pectusculum:
and the breast.
cumque ambo oblata Domino consecraverit,
And when he will have offered and consecrated both to the Lord,
tradet sacerdoti,
he shall deliver them to the priest,
qui adolebit adipem super altare,
who shall burn the fat upon the altar.
pectusculum autem erit Aaron et filiorum ejus.
But the breast shall be for Aaron and his sons.
Armus quoque dexter de pacificorum hostiis cedet in primitias sacerdotis.
Likewise also, the right shoulder of the victim of peace offerings shall fall to the priest as first-fruits.
Qui obtulerit sanguinem et adipem filiorum Aaron,
Among the sons of Aaron, whoever will have offered the blood and the fat,
ipse habebit et armum dextrum in portione sua.
the same one shall also have the right shoulder for his portion.
Pectusculum enim elevationis,
So then, the breast that is lifted up,
et armum separationis,
and the shoulder that is separated,
tuli a filiis Israël de hostiis eorum pacificis,
I have taken from the sons of Israel, from their victims of peace offerings,
et dedi Aaron sacerdoti, et filiis ejus,
and I have given these to Aaron the priest and to his sons,
lege perpetua,
as a law in perpetuity,
ab omni populo Israël.
from all the people of Israel.
Hæc est unctio Aaron et filiorum ejus in cæremoniis Domini die qua obtulit eos Moyses,
This is the anointing of Aaron and his sons, by the ceremonies of the Lord, in the day when Moses offered them,
ut sacerdotio fungerentur,
so that they may fulfill the priesthood,
et quæ præcepit eis dari Dominus a filiis Israël religione perpetua in generationibus suis.
and this is what the Lord instructed to be given to them by the sons of Israel, as a perpetual observance in their generations.
Ista est lex holocausti,
This is the law of the holocaust,
et sacrificii pro peccato
and of the sacrifice for sin,
atque delicto,
and for transgression,
et pro consecratione
and for consecration,
et pacificorum victimis,
and for the victims of peace offerings,
quam constituit Dominus Moysi in monte Sinai,
which the Lord appointed to Moses on mount Sinai,
quando mandabit filiis Israël ut offerrent oblationes suas Domino in deserto Sinai.
when he commanded the sons of Israel to offer their oblations to the Lord in the desert of Sinai.
